chunks.l2:
[tsa-a09-v01] That, sevenfold, the six-and-half-fold scripture is taught by the Supreme Lord alone.

[tsa-a09-v10] She alone, desiring the will-power-form, autonomy-natured, of the mantra-great-Lord.

[tsa-a09-v11] Will-natured, distinct-autonomy-natured, of Śiva — thus the power-differences: seven primary.

[tsa-a09-v12] And the difference in the power-bearing knower-objects is made by its tainting: instrument-difference ends in agent-difference; and from power alone — non-separate — being able to act; not of another, from the fallacy of infinite regress and the rest.

[tsa-a09-v13] In reality, however, one alone — consciousness-autonomy-bliss-resting knower; there earth, resting in own-nature-merely, when known, its own nature alone shines: seen by the mind's eye, known by the mind, I know — there the other own-nature made by complete-power, made by power-bearing-form, shines too; thus up to Śiva also is to be said: world established in Śiva-power, resting in Śiva-nature, I know — from the conviction being of a different kind.

[tsa-a09-v14] But if the state's knowability is its own body, then knowability toward all, knowability of the knowable too — infinite regress; by that, the world's blindness well-luminous; by that, the union of opposite qualities in knowable-unknowable: fault — so it is said here.

[tsa-a09-v15] Not that own body: from own-nature being separately said; but what? In knower-power and in the knower the rest-receptacle, the form — that self-luminous itself shines, not toward anything at all: thus omniscience; regress and opposite-quality-union — far removed.

[tsa-a09-v16] Known by infinite knower-objects too: one alone, its form in those, from the one-shining-form nature: no obstruction by another knower's knowing-inference; and that its form is real, from doing work for meaning; like seeing a beloved seen by another becoming jealous: seeing Śiva-nature, the rest-pot, one enters completely; seeing reality resting in all infinite knower-objects one becomes full, like watching a dancer; her blue's form resting in the knower — from the arising of self-luminous contemplation: thus the fifteenfold nature of earth up to the principal tattva.

[tsa-a09-v02] There: Śivas, mantra-great-Lords, mantra-Lords, mantras, knowledge-portions, dissolution-portions, complete — seven power-bearing.

[tsa-a09-v03] Of these seven powers, by their difference up to the earth-and-rest principal tattva: each its own form by fourteen differences — fifteenfold.

[tsa-a09-v04] There: own form fit for knowability, self-established, by the grace of Aparābhaṭṭārikā — in the power-raised knower-objects the rest-receptacle: that is the śākta form itself, by the grace of Śrīmatparāparā; and that too is sevenfold, from the powers being as many.

[tsa-a09-v05] In the power-bearing-form-principal, however, what rests in the knower-class: that power-bearing Siva-form, by the grace of Śrīmatparābhaṭṭārikā — sevenfold too.

[tsa-a09-v06] From Śiva to the complete-limit — from those many being said.

[tsa-a09-v07] There the difference of knower-objects is from power-difference alone; and for clarification it is said by the order of complete and the rest: in complete, knowledge-portion, power — from being its specific form (the mind-, action- and instrument-powers); of the dissolution-portion, those same from objectlessness, indistinct.

[tsa-a09-v08] Of the knowledge-portion, those same, in the dissolving-portion, helper of its impression, awakening — the pure knowledge of mantra.

[tsa-a09-v09] Devoid of that impression: she alone awakened, of the mantra-Lord.
chunks.sanskrit: tantrasāra, navamam āhnikam sa ca saptadhā ṣaḍardhaśāstra eva paraṃ parameśena uktaḥ // abhts_9.1 tatra śivāḥ mantramaheśāḥ mantreśāḥ mantrāḥ vijñānākalāḥ pralayākalāḥ sakalā iti sapta śaktimantaḥ // abhts_9.2 eṣāṃ saptaiva śaktayaḥ tadbhedāt pṛthivyādipradhānatattvāntaṃ caturdaśabhir bhedaiḥ pratyekaṃ svaṃ rūpaṃ pañcadaśam // abhts_9.3 tatra svaṃ rūpaṃ prameyatāyogyaṃ svātmaniṣṭham aparābhaṭṭārikānugrahāt pramātṛṣu udriktaśaktiṣu yat viśrāntibhājanaṃ tat tasyaiva śāktaṃ rūpaṃ śrīmatparāparānugrahāt tac ca saptavidhaṃ śaktīnāṃ tāvattvāt // abhts_9.4 śaktimadrūpapradhāne tu pramātṛvarge yat viśrāntaṃ tac chaktimac chivarūpaṃ śrīmatparābhaṭṭārikānugrahāt tad api saptavidham // abhts_9.5 pramātṝṇāṃ śivāt prabhṛti sakalāntānāṃ tāvatām uktatvāt // abhts_9.6 tatra śaktibhedād eva pramātṝṇāṃ bhedaḥ sa ca sphuṭīkaraṇārthaṃ sakalādikrameṇa bhaṇyate tatra sakalasya vidyākale śaktiḥ tadviśeṣarūpatvāt buddhikarmākṣaśaktīnāṃ pralayākalasya tu te eva nirviṣayatvāt asphuṭe // abhts_9.7 vijñānākalasya te eva vigalatkalpe tatsaṃskārasacivā prabudhyamānā śuddhavidyā mantrasya // abhts_9.8 tatsaṃskārahīnā saiva prabuddhā mantreśasya // abhts_9.9 saiva icchāśaktirūpatāṃ svātantryasvabhāvāṃ jighṛkṣantī mantramaheśvarasya // abhts_9.10 icchātmikā sphuṭasvātantryātmikā śivasya iti śaktibhedāḥ sapta mukhyāḥ // abhts_9.11 taduparāgakṛtaś ca śaktimatsu pramātṛṣu bhedaḥ karaṇabhedasya kartṛbhedaparyavasānāt śakter eva ca avyatiriktāyāḥ karaṇīkartuṃ śakyatvāt na anyasya anavasthādyāpatteḥ // abhts_9.12 vastutaḥ punar eka eva citsvātantryānandaviśrāntaḥ pramātā tatra pṛthivī svarūpamātraviśrāntā yadā vedyate tadā svarūpam asyāḥ kevalaṃ bhāti caitracakṣurdṛṣṭaṃ caitraviditaṃ jānāmīti tatra sakalaśaktikṛtaṃ sakalaśaktimadrūpakṛtaṃ svarūpāntaraṃ bhāty eva evaṃ śivāntam api vācyaṃ śivaśaktiniṣṭhaṃ śivasvabhāvaviśrāntaṃ ca viśvaṃ jānāmi iti pratyayasya vilakṣaṇasya bhāvāt // abhts_9.13 nanu bhāvasya cet vedyatā svaṃ vapuḥ tat sarvān prati vedyatvaṃ vedyatvam api vedyam ity anavasthā tayā ca jagato 'ndhasuptatvaṃ suprakāśam eva tayā ca vedyatvāvedyatve viruddhadharmayoga iti doṣaḥ atra ucyate // abhts_9.14 na tat svaṃ vapuḥ svarūpasya pṛthaguktatvāt kiṃ tarhi tat pramātṛśaktau pramātari ca yat viśrāntibhājanaṃ yat rūpaṃ tat khalu tat tat svaprakāśam eva tat prakāśate na tu kiṃcid api prati iti sarvajñatvam anavasthāviruddhadharmayogaś ca iti dūrāpāstam // abhts_9.15 anantapramātṛsaṃvedyam api ekam eva tat tasya rūpaṃ tāvati teṣām ekābhāsarūpatvāt iti na pramātrantarasaṃvedanānumānavighnaḥ kaścit tac ca tasya rūpaṃ satyam arthakriyākāritvāt tathaiva paradṛśyamānāṃ kāntāṃ dṛṣṭvā tasyai samīrṣyati śivasvabhāvaṃ viśrāntikumbhaṃ paśyan samāviśati samastānantapramātṛviśrāntaṃ vastu paśyan pūrṇībhavati nartakīprekṣaṇavat tasyaiva nīlasya tadrūpaṃ pramātari yat viśrāntaṃ tathaiva svaprakāśasya vimarśasyodayāt iti pañcadaśātmakatvaṃ pṛthivyāḥ prabhṛti pradhānatattvaparyantam // abhts_9.16

chunks.l2:
[tsa-a09-v17] In that much — the complete's knower-nature from the raised passion-and-rest curtain — the complete's fifteenfoldness too thus, from its that-much knowability.

[tsa-a09-v18] Spread, this is settled in the Tantrāloka.

[tsa-a09-v19] From the male up to the segment-tattva: thirteenfold.

[tsa-a09-v20] Complete's there, by union with knower-nature, from suppression of its two differences power/power-bearing-self: thus complete's own-nature merely; the dissolution-portion's in own-nature, five's in knower-nature: eleven differences.

[tsa-a09-v21] The knowledge-portion's in own-nature, four's in knower-nature: nine differences.

[tsa-a09-v22] Mantra's in own-nature, three's in knower-nature: seven.

[tsa-a09-v23] The mantra-Lord's in own-nature, two's in knower-nature: five.

[tsa-a09-v24] The mantra-great-Lord's in own-nature, the Lord's one alone in knower-nature, from power-power-bearing-difference: three.

[tsa-a09-v25] Śiva's, however — dependent on light-one-consciousness-autonomy: no difference at all, from fullness.

[tsa-a09-v26] Thus tattva-difference itself is established in the Supreme-Lord's unsurpassable-policy-one-name, and makes the variegation of world-difference: of hell, heaven and rudra-worlds, earthness being equal too, from the farther nature-difference being said.

[tsa-a09-v27] And here, by mutual construction of difference, curious for inner-difference-knowledge: let him determine the Tantrāloka alone.

[tsa-a09-v28] Thus by following each pot and the rest too, the difference of earth-and-rest tattvas is established.

[tsa-a09-v29] Now the whole earth-tattva, targeted as knower-known-form, is established: what by earth-tattva-non-difference is light — that is Śiva.

[tsa-a09-v30] As the Vedic text: in earth this very brahman.

[tsa-a09-v31] It impels the giving of earth-tattva-attainment: the earth-mantra-great-Lord; impelled, the earth-mantra-Lord; his expressive mantra made of imagined-image-nature, by the order of Sāṃkhya-and-rest bonded-knowledge-crossed-Śiva-knowledge, the practiced earth-yoga not reaching the stable stage: the earth-knowledge-portion.

[tsa-a09-v32] By bonded-knowledge-order the practiced earth-yoga: at cosmic-end or in death, earth-dissolution-alone.

[tsa-a09-v33] In deep sleep, from tattva-immersion alone, varied dream would arise; the earth-identity-grasped, however: earth-complete.

[tsa-a09-v34] Even here by power-raising-absence-nature: fourteenfold — thus the differences of the earth-tattva having attained knower-nature; own-nature, however, pure knowable — thus elsewhere-here-in-even.

[tsa-a09-v35] Now in one knower, by being established in breath, the difference-determination: here the blue-grasping one, breath, sixteen-segment-self, rises up to knowable-immersion. There the first segment indivisible-one-form; the second knower-exultation-form; the last knowable-identical pervaded; the penultimate manifested-knower-form; in the middle, the twelve-segment — from among them the first six-group non-conceptual-natured, covering-concept sixness: as its own nature one segment; in the covering-concept five-form-nature, dawning-willingness, already-dawned — she two-segment-bodied from pulsation's absence-of-one-instant-form, own-work-agent-nature — thus from the covering-concept's fivefoldness, and from own-nature six non-conceptual instants; then from non-conceptual's dissolution-likeness: dissolution of concept, dawning-willingness, two-segment-bodied already-dawned: six segments.
chunks.sanskrit: tāvaty udriktarāgādikañcukasya sakalasya pramātṛtvāt sakalasyāpi evaṃ pāñcadaśyaṃ tasyāpi tāvad vedyatvāt // abhts_9.17 vitatya caitat nirṇītaṃ tantrāloke // abhts_9.18 puṃsaḥ prabhṛti kalātattvāntaṃ trayodaśadhā // abhts_9.19 sakalasya tatra pramātṛtāyogena tacchaktiśaktimadātmano bhedadvayasya pratyastamayāt tathā ca sakalasya svarūpatvam eva kevalaṃ pralayākalasya svarūpatve pañcānāṃ pramātṛtve ekādaśa bhedāḥ // abhts_9.20 vijñānākalasya svarūpatve caturṇāṃ pramātṛtve nava bhedāḥ // abhts_9.21 mantrasya svarūpatve trayāṇāṃ pramātṛtve sapta // abhts_9.22 mantreśasya svarūpatve dvayoḥ pramātṛtve pañca // abhts_9.23 mantramaheśasya svarūpatve bhagavata ekasyaiva pramātṛtve śaktiśaktimadbhedāt trayaḥ // abhts_9.24 śivasya tu prakāśaikacitsvātantryanirbharasya na ko 'pi bhedaḥ paripūrṇatvāt // abhts_9.25 evam ayaṃ tattvabheda eva parameśvarānuttaranayaikākhye nirūpitaḥ bhuvanabhedavaicitryaṃ karoti narakasvargarudrabhuvanānāṃ pārthivatve samāne 'pi dūratarasya svabhāvabhedasya uktatvāt // abhts_9.26 atra ca parasparaṃ bhedakalanayā avāntarabhedajñānakutūhalī tantrālokam eva avadhārayet // abhts_9.27 evam ekaikaghaṭādyanusāreṇāpi pṛthivyādīnāṃ tattvānāṃ bhedo nirūpitaḥ // abhts_9.28 adhunā samastaṃ pṛthivītattvaṃ pramātṛprameyarūpam uddiśya nirūpyate yo dharātattvābhedena prakāśaḥ sa śivaḥ // abhts_9.29 yathā śrutiḥ pṛthivy evedaṃ brahma iti // abhts_9.30 dharātattvasiddhipradān prerayati sa dharāmantramaheśvaraḥ preryo dharāmantreśaḥ tasyaivābhimānikavigrahatātmako vācako mantraḥ sāṃkhyādipāśavavidyottīrṇaśivavidyākrameṇa abhyastapārthivayogo 'prāptadhruvapadaḥ dharāvijñānākalaḥ // abhts_9.31 pāśavavidyākrameṇa abhyastapārthivayogaḥ kalpānte maraṇe vā dharāpralayakevalaḥ // abhts_9.32 sauṣupte hi tattvāveśavaśād eva citrasya svapnasya udayaḥ syāt gṛhītadharābhimānas tu dharāsakalaḥ // abhts_9.33 atrāpi śaktyudrekanyagbhāvābhyāṃ caturdaśatvam iti pramātṛtāpannasya dharātattvasya bhedāḥ svarūpaṃ tu śuddhaṃ prameyam iti evam aparatrāpi // abhts_9.34 atha ekasmin pramātari prāṇapratiṣṭhitatayā bhedanirūpaṇam iha nīlaṃ gṛhṇataḥ prāṇaḥ tuṭiṣoḍaśakātmā vedyāveśaparyantam udeti tatra ādyā tuṭir avibhāgaikarūpā dvitīyā grāhakollāsarūpā antyā tu grāhyābhinnā tanmayī upāntyā tu sphuṭībhūtagrāhakarūpā madhye tu yat tuṭidvādaśaka tanmadhyāt ādyaṃ ṣaṭkaṃ nirvikalpasvabhāvaṃ vikalpāc chādakaṃ ṣaṭtvaṃ ca asya svarūpeṇa ekā tuṭiḥ ācchādanīye ca vikalpe pañcarūpatvam unmimiṣā unmiṣattā sā ca iyaṃ sphuṭakriyārūpatvāt tuṭidvayātmikā spandanasya ekakṣaṇarūpatvābhāvāt unmiṣitatā svakāryakartṛtvaṃ ca ity evam ācchādanīyavikalpapāñcavidhyāt svarūpāc ca ṣaṭ kṣaṇā nirvikalpakāḥ tato 'pi nirvikalpasya dhvaṃsamānatā dhvaṃso vikalpasya unmimiṣā unmiṣattā tuṭidvayātmikā unmiṣitatā ca iti ṣaṭ tuṭayaḥ // abhts_9.35

chunks.l2:
[tsa-a09-v36] Own-work-agent-nature is knower-form-nature — said; she is not counted further — thus the wise-wealthed, practising the teacher's instruction, distinguish fifteenfoldness everywhere by division.

[tsa-a09-v37] In concept-lack: segment-lack, in bliss-and-rest-knowing — like, as far as non-conceptualness alone.

[tsa-a09-v38] The worlds too, by concept-rest, consider that ego-made, the spread-of-this-being-concept-covered, non-conceptual contemplation-abode unlit — like a suffering-state resting in bliss; but by concept-decrease she shines indeed — thus this attentiveness in the relation of knowable and knower: the Abhinavagupta-teachers.

[tsa-a09-v39] Thus in fifteenfold standing, as far as the lack of the distinct this-ness-self's difference, so much pair-pair diminishes; as far as two-segment Śiva-immersion: there the first segment everywhere complete; the second pervaded-by-all-knowledge-instruments being-practised, fit for omniscience-omnipotence — not the first.

[tsa-a09-v40] As Śrīkallaṭa says: segment-fall — here the fall-word: she alone the Goddess Śrīmatkālī, mother-being-nature, Bhairava, intuition — enough, by secret-and-unsecret.

[tsa-a09-v41] Thus from the mantra-great-Lord-segment onward, from the practice of that-and-that, attainment of that-and-that.

[tsa-a09-v42] Now here the waking-and-rest states are established: the variegation of the knowable and its object and consciousness — mutually-relative being — that is a state: not of the knowable-merely, nor of consciousness-merely, nor two separate.

[tsa-a09-v43] There when, by object-rulership, by external-form-nature, shining: waking-state, in-knowable, in-mother, in-measure.

[tsa-a09-v44] When, however, right there by substratum-form-nature shining — will: dream-state.

[tsa-a09-v45] When, however, right there by ruler-form-nature shining, by seed-self-nature alone: deep-sleep-state.

[tsa-a09-v46] These three known-instrument-knower-states, each by the waking-and-rest difference: fourfold said.

[tsa-a09-v47] When, however, in the very knower-rest-gone, from the knower's fullness-turning, by its door fullness-turning shining: fourth-state; she form I-see — of this kind the triad-of-portions crossed, I-see-thus: unmediated knower-nature, autonomy-essence, not by sameness-middleness-farness gives the anointing of knower-instrument-known-ness; from serving the three states: threefold.

[tsa-a09-v48] This four-state-set yogins employ by the words piṇḍa-stha, padastha, rūpastha, rūpa-atīta; the contemplation-wealthy, however: by the words all-auspicious, pervasion, great-pervasion, accumulation.

[tsa-a09-v49] And the corresponding-sense is shown here in the Tantrāloka and the Ślokavārttika.

[tsa-a09-v50] And what is contained in all, complete-form — that beyond-fourth, beyond-all, great-accumulation: they establish.

[tsa-a09-v51] Moreover whose what, when form distinct, stable, continuous — that is waking; its opposite, dream; which is the dissolution-portion's enjoyment, all-knowing: deep sleep; which the knowledge-portion's enjoyment, identifying-with-enjoyable: fourth; mantra-and-rest's: that enjoyment of states, Śiva-non-difference; beyond-fourth, beyond-all.

[tsa-a09-v52] There self-nature-complete-pair: 1 dissolution-portion, 2 knowledge-portion, 3 mantra-those-Lords-great-Lords-class, 4 Śiva, 5 — thus in the fifteenfold five states.

[tsa-a09-v53] Self-nature dissolution-portion and-rest-by-order in thirteenfold self-nature knowledge-portion-power; knowledge-portion in elevenfold self-nature mantras those-Lords great-Lords Śiva — in ninefold self-nature mantra-Lords great-Lord power Śiva — in sevenfold self-nature great-Lord-power great-Lord power Śiva — in fivefold self-nature action-power knowledge-power will-power Śiva — in threefold, in non-different too, in Śiva-tattva by structuring as action-knowledge-will-bliss-consciousness-form, the contemplation-wealthy say five-stage-nature.
chunks.sanskrit: svakāryakartṛtā tu grāhakarūpatā iti uktaṃ na sā bhūyo gaṇyate ity evaṃ vivekadhanā gurūpaveśānuśīlinaḥ sarvatra pāñcadaśyaṃ pravibhāgena viviñcate // abhts_9.36 vikalpanyūnatve tu tuṭinyūnatā sukhādisaṃvittāv iva yāvat avikalpataiva // abhts_9.37 lokās tu vikalpaviśrāntyā tām ahaṃtāmayīm ahaṃtācchāditedaṃbhāvavikalpaprasarāṃ nirvikalpāṃ vimarśabhuvam aprakāśitām iva manyante cāpi kevalāyāḥ saṃvido na cāpi pṛthak pṛthak dve // abhts_9.42 tatra yadādhiṣṭheyatayā bahīrūpatayā bhānaṃ tadā jāgradavasthā meye mātari māne ca // abhts_9.43 yadā tu tatraiva adhiṣṭhānarūpatayā bhānaṃ saṃkalpaḥ tadā svapnāvasthā // abhts_9.44 yadā tu tatraiva adhiṣṭhātṛrūpatayā bījātmatayaiva bhānaṃ tadā suṣuptāvasthā // abhts_9.45 imā eva tisraḥ prameyapramāṇapramātravasthāḥ pratyekaṃ jāgradādibhedāt caturvidhā uktāḥ // abhts_9.46 yadā tu tasminn eva pramātṛviśrāntigate pramātuḥ pūrṇataunmukhyāt taddvāreṇa pūrṇatonmukhatayā bhānaṃ tadā turyāvasthā sā ca rūpaṃ dṛśāham ity evaṃvidham aṃśatrayam uttīrya paśyāmīti anupāyikā pramātṛtā svātantryasārā naikaṭyamadhyatvadūratvaiḥ pramātṛpramāṇaprameyatābhiṣekaṃ dadatī tadavasthātrayānugrāhakatvāt tribhedā // abhts_9.47 etad eva
